_comment: Maps each Axe Auditor test case (by its exact name) to the dashboard domain its audits represent. Audits usually run against a dev, QA, or staging host, so the domain here is the PRODUCTION site the audit stands for, following the team's convention (abledev.dot.ny.gov is recorded as able.dot.ny.gov). A null domain means nobody has confirmed the production site yet; those runs are kept in data/auditor-runs.json but do not reach the dashboard until a domain is filled in. Re-run `npm run generate` (or `generate:offline`) after editing.
